log.notes_to_self: Plan: all quick kills in the afternoon only, so L can only rule out day workers (pool about 55k). Kill every national criminal. Beyond that, only kill criminals reported in forum and/or foreign. Never kill ones whose places include regional:East, gazette or clips, unless national is also in that criminal's list (a trace then shows national, which everyone watches, so it is harmless). Worst case pool about 55k*0.25*0.25 = 3.4k, which is safe. Watch the press conferences. If the pool approaches 2k, kill national only.
